description: List all rim widths (in inches) available, optionally filtered by diameter and bolt pattern. Use this to discover valid rim_width values for search-by-rim.

bolt_pattern.description: Bolt pattern (PCD) filter, expressed as stud-count × circle-diameter in mm (e.g. "5x112", "4x100"). Use list-rim-bolt-patterns to enumerate valid values.

region.description: Market region code (e.g. "eudm", "usdm"). Get codes from list-regions.

rim_diameter.description: Rim diameter in inches (e.g. 18). Must be positive. Filters results to this diameter only.

name: list-rim-widths
